verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Identical formula, written once for a general moment weight e instead of twice: physicalDensity P e q (r,p) = momentDensity P e (r/√(q p)) / (√(q p))^(e+1), which at e = 2 is q^{-3/2} σ̂(r/√q) and at e = 1 is q^{-1} σ̂(r/√q), matching the two displayed rows; q is a function of the slow point p, as in the paper's moving q. The paper fixes two arbitrary interior profiles σ̂_θ, σ̂_z subject only to ∫ξ²σ̂_θ = ∫ξσ̂_z = 1; the Lean instantiates them by the one concrete family momentDensity P e = inversePower P e · density P, which satisfies exactly that normalization (momentDensity_moment) and is smooth with support in the patch (momentDensity_contDiff, momentDensity_tsupport ⊆ Ioo P.a P.b). Making one admissible choice is what the paper's 'Fix interior profiles' licenses, so this is a specialization and not a weakening.
